text:
emma (sales): quick heads-up we've got an enterprise buyer asking for a firm H2 commit. POC in 3 weeks, target steady 1800 qps, avg 256 tokens, 99th <200ms. need recommendation on reserved GPU runway + autoscale + fallback.
rajiv (solutions): do we know model family? 70B dense vs 4bit-quant will change numbers a lot. ask customer for model preference and 7-day qps histogram.
mike t. (infra): ballpark calc for quantized 4bit variant: assume ~10k tokens/s per A100-equivalent under our batching. 1800 qps * 256 tokens ~= 460k tokens/s -> ~46 GPUs. add 20% headroom -> 55. recommend reserved pool = 56 GPUs + 12 burst credits for spikes.
sofia (rev ops): pricing options to propose: soft-commit (30% discount, 2-week rolling exit) and hard-commit (45% discount, 3mo notice + SLA). i'll prepare cost delta rows for POC -> prod.
chloe (security): POC must satisfy data residency and KMS requirements. our default: metadata-only logs; payload logging off unless customer enables and routes to their SSE-KMS S3. include that in the security Q answers. also need SOC artifacts attached.
emma (sales): customer also wants autoscale + automatic fallback to smaller/quantized model if tail latency spikes. can we provide a starter policy and a short runbook?
capacity-bot: generated suggested autoscale policy based on historical similar workloads.
rajiv (solutions): starter autoscale snippet (tweak after POC telemetry):

```
autoscale_policy: min_replicas: 48; max_replicas: 72; scale_up: metric=request_latency_99 threshold=180ms step=+4; scale_down: metric=gpu_util threshold=40% step=-2; fallback: model_variant=4bit-optimized trigger_latency=250ms
```

rajiv (solutions): notes: min_replicas aligns to reserved baseline; fallback routes to compatible variant when 99th >250ms for sustained 15s.
mike t. (infra): ops caveats: pre-warm KV cache for clients with large prefix reuse -> can reduce GPU needs by ~10-15%. run a canary with worst-case seq length to validate kernel selection. also recommend 10% extra buffer for promotion days.
sofia (rev ops): emma ask customer for 7-day qps histogram + p50/p95/p99; i'll model packing and the two pricing scenarios once we have it.
chloe (security): add to questionnaire draft: Are model params/prompts/outputs logged? Answer: by default no payload logs; optional customer-controlled S3 with SSE-KMS if enabled.
emma (sales): perfect. i'll assemble a POC packet: runbook, autoscale snippet, two pricing rows, security Q answers, and SLA fallback clause. will share with customer today. thanks! :thumbsup:
capacity-bot: policy saved as /policies/1778129999-reserved-runway-hedge.json
